_comment: Live-execution AD range: a REAL Samba Active Directory Domain Controller, the Railway-native equivalent of a GOAD/Ludus Windows range (Railway has no Windows or nested virtualization). Deploy ONLY to a NONPRODUCTION environment - this deliberately exposes an attackable DC on the internet for boards 5-6.

networking.publicProxy: TCP proxy on the candidate-facing AD ports (53, 88, 389, 445, 636, 3268)
networking.proofPort: 9443 is PRIVATE-only (portal reads expected proof material); never TCP-proxied

variables.ADRANGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: <secret - strong random; proof target is its NT hash>
variables.ADRANGE_FOOTHOLD_PASSWORD: <secret - the creds the candidate is given>

portal_wiring._comment: Set ONLY on the parallax-nonprod portal, never production. Enables the live range for boards 5-6 alongside the deterministic engine.
portal_wiring.ADRANGE_HOST: <the Railway TCP proxy host, e.g. caboose.proxy.rlwy.net>
portal_wiring.ADRANGE_FOOTHOLD_PASSWORD: <same as the DC secret - shown to the candidate as their foothold>
portal_wiring.ADRANGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: <same as the DC secret - portal derives the proof NT hash>
